sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT v,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST('0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST(NULL AS FLOAT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(v),ROLLUP(V)) q WHERE gid=1 ORDER BY gid,n

SELECT * FROM (SELECT v AS k,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST('0' AS FLOAT)),(CAST(NULL AS FLOAT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k),ROLLUP(K)) q WHERE k IS NULL ORDER BY gid,n
SELECT * FROM (SELECT v,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS INT)),(CAST('0' AS INT)),(CAST(NULL AS INT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(v),ROLLUP(V)) q WHERE gid=1 ORDER BY gid,n

SELECT * FROM (SELECT v AS k,grouping_id() AS gid,count(*) AS n FROM (VALUES(CAST('-0' AS INT)),(CAST('0' AS INT)),(CAST(NULL AS INT))) t(v) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k),ROLLUP(K)) q WHERE k IS NULL ORDER BY gid,n
